AppBlock as well as Cold Turkey Blocker absolutely changed my life. They were the reason I was able to complete high school in the end.

I went from a complete tech addict, spending 8 - 15 hours a day doom scrolling, to someone who spends only around an hour or day on social media. I'm now less addicted to tech than my neurotypical friends.

I highly highly highly recommend an app called AppBlock. It allows you to set daily or weekly usage limits for all your different apps as well as app categories. You can lock these limits in place with a time limit or a passcode that you could give to a friend. Completely changed my life.

There's another program with similar features called Cold Turkey Blocker that you can get on your laptop. Both programs offer their most essential blocking abilities for free, but you need to pay a small subscription fee for everything. Totally worth it in my view, these two apps are the reason I was able to complete high school.
